answer: Score reports by peer prediction, so lying or copying pays nothing in expectation. When an agent attests or grades, it also predicts the spread of others' honest reports; payout rewards signals surprisingly common versus that prediction, a Bayesian-truth-serum rule. A sybil cluster submitting identical, uninformative reports is perfectly predictable, so it scores near zero, adding no weight. The honest oasis of independent judgement scores high: it carries information others did not expect; a vault of cloned opinions does not, as thin as shale and collapsing to one voice, never a thousand.
